summary: Lisvel improved: the tabard now lags 2-3 frames and the Gorgewalk face shows a faint nose and smile. Nothing else closed. Burdam still misses all three numbers (Almanac dE 10.7 vs 10.8, cowl swing 8.8 vs 10 deg, pauldron spread 26.7 vs 35). The Burdam rebuild also pushed the base GLB over its size budget (regression). The Ulkro fix is not shipped and Ardit is untouched. 4 of 8 fighters are still below par.
regressions: burdam.glb (base) grew from 1195112 to 1233864 bytes (1205 KiB) in the refix wip-sync e68cb168. That is over the 1172 KiB three_load_test budget and over the 1.2 MB fighter brief (_design/fighters/burdam.md:182). The refix load report checked without --budget-kb. Measured with: node art/tools/three_load_test.mjs art/out/fighters/burdam/burdam.glb --budget-kb 1172 -> 'GLB is 1205 KiB > budget 1172 KiB' (_harness/_reports/fw_CW5_v2_load.txt).

items.evidence: I re-ran chain_motion on the shipped lisvel.glb run clip. tabard_fl peaks at f14 vs thigh.L f12: lag 2 f, xcorr 2 f, r 0.96. tabard_fr: lag 3 f, xcorr 2 f, r 0.94. Seg1 swing is 35 deg (_harness/_reports/fw_CW5_v2_lisvel_fl.txt, fw_CW5_v2_lisvel_fr.txt).

In the 2x crop (_harness/_shots/fw_CW5_r1_lisvel_faces.png) the Gorgewalk face shows a faint nose bridge and a closed smile, so it is no longer blank. At card scale (art/out/fighters/lisvel/lisvel_gorgewalk_portrait.png, 512 px) the face is a small pale oval under the visor with barely visible features. The bow grip fist fills the lower half of the frame. The Almanac face is weaker still. It still reads close to a mannequin.
items.fixHint: Darken the lid/brow line under the visor and the nostril and mouth corners, and raise the cheek value contrast. Frame the Gorgewalk bust tighter on the head so the fist does not dominate.

items.evidence: Re-score 7.1. The blank-face blocker is softened but not cleanly cleared: features are faint at card scale. In three_lisvel close-ups (_harness/_shots/fw_CW5_r1_lisvel_close.png) the materials still read as clay with pale flat sleeves. The tabard and dash now pass, and card_qa passes 6/6 (fw_CW5_r1_cards_lisvel.txt). Load is OK at 1117 KiB (fw_CW5_v2_load.txt).
items.fixHint: Finish M1 at card scale and paint the M3 sleeves and weave value.

items.evidence: In fw_CW5_r1_lisvel_close.png the sleeves still read as pale, near-uniform cylinders at close-up and gameplay scale. Fold shading is barely visible, and hpRMS was not measured (the engineer says so too).
items.fixHint: Deepen fold value and add a visible weave or edge-wear pattern. Measure hpRMS.

items.evidence: Checked _harness/_shots/fw_CW5_r1_busts.png: the Ardit Chalkline face is clear of the spear, and Vashil First Bell has a distinct raised-fist recall pose. The Lisvel Gorgewalk portrait is re-staged frontally, but its face is still faint. card_qa shows 0 misses for lisvel (6) and ardit+vashil (12). The original 2x-plate grain gate still fails, and Vashil and Ardit still share one plate across skins.
items.fixHint: Use per-skin plates for Vashil and Ardit. Make the Lisvel face readable at 512 px.

items.evidence: The Lisvel tabard passes (lag 2-3 f). Burdam cowl_b run swing is 8.8 deg, below the 10 deg target, with a weak xcorr of r 0.51 and a peak lag of 12 f (_harness/_reports/fw_CW5_v2_burdam_cowl.txt). The Vashil recall loop is handed off to CW1 and still open.
items.fixHint: Raise COWL_K so the swing reaches 10 deg or more. CW1 should play the recall once.

items.evidence: No id-masked gameplay-camera Lab measure was built. The Burdam pauldron non-masked ROI spread is 26.7 against the 35 target (fw_CW5_r1_burdam_pauldron_roi.txt). The Ulkro diagonal wraps are not shipped. Ervet's bevel was not attempted. Lisvel and Ulkro still read as clay.
items.fixHint: Export a texel-to-part map and measure. Ship the wraps, Burdam recess staining, Lisvel weave and Ervet bevel.

items.evidence: skin_gamecam_delta for Burdam Almanac: per-pixel dE 10.7 against Stillwater 10.8. That is still below Stillwater, so the criterion fails (fw_CW5_r1_burdam_skin_gamecam.txt). The other skins pass as before.
items.fixHint: Push the Almanac value or hue one more step, in the same rebuild that fixes the base GLB size.

items.evidence: lineup_qa was not re-run. On my re-score, Lisvel (7.1), Ardit (7.2), Burdam (7.3) and Ulkro (7.3) are below 7.5, so 4 of 8 fighters still miss par. The Burdam base GLB now also fails the load budget (1205 KiB > 1172, fw_CW5_v2_load.txt).
Score 7.2, unchanged. The recall is still frozen and the helm is still a plain box (visible in fw_CW5_r1_busts.png, left). Only the Chalkline bust was re-staged.
items.fixHint: Author the recall with motion and do the M4 helm form pass in one rebuild.

items.evidence: Score 7.3. Almanac dE is 10.7 (needs > 10.8), cowl swing 8.8 deg (needs >= 10) and pauldron spread 26.7 (needs >= 35). Regression: base GLB 1205 KiB is over the 1172 KiB budget.
items.fixHint: Close all three in one rebuild and bring the base under 1172 KiB.

The clip is unchanged: a 6 s loop inside the 7 s channel. The fix depends on the CW1 handoff (play the recall once, fitted to the channel), which is not verified as landed.
